B0DN63SFWL.title: Aqara Thread/Zigbee Smart LED Light Bulb T2 E26, 1 Pack
bullets: Dual Protocol Support - Zigbee & Thread: The Aqara LED Bulb T2 supports Zigbee and Thread protocols for versatile connectivity. In Zigbee mode, access exclusive Aqara features and Matter compatibility via an Aqara hub (compatible Aqara hub is required). Thread mode allows direct integration with Matter-enabled ecosystems like Apple Home, Google Home, and Alexa, ensuring low-latency, robust connectivity.(*To use the device with a particular Matter ecosystem, a Matter Controller of this ecosystem and a Thread Border Router are required.)

Ultra-Wide Tunable Whites & 16 Million Colors: Delivering superior illumination with a lumen of 1100lm , this LED bulb offers a broad spectrum of shades, from radiant whites with an extra-high color temperature range of 2000-9000K to 16 million vibrant colors, with a color rendering index of Ra>90, transforming your space with the perfect light to match any mood or occasion.

Circadian Lighting Syncs with Nature in Zigbee mode: Currently, it is NOT supported in Thread Mode. (*To experience this feature in Zigbee Mode, a compatible Aqara hub is required). It is also fully compatible with Apple HomeKit Adaptive Lighting, allowing it to automatically adjust its color temperature throughout the day. This feature ensures that your lighting is always optimized for comfort and ambiance, adapting seamlessly to the natural changes in daylight.

Power-Off Memory Support: You will have full control to configure whether the light turns on or off automatically after a power outage. This means you can prevent unexpected lighting disturbances, such as lights turning on suddenly in the middle of the night, ensuring your comfort and peace of mind.(*This feature is available in both Zigbee and Thread modes.)

Automations with Aqara and Third-Party Devices: Elevate your smart lighting experience with this device's powerful automation capabilities in Aqara Home and Third Party ecosystems**. Effortlessly create and trigger personalized home scenes, enabling you to tailor your environment precisely to your lifestyle and preferences.(*To experience this feature in Zigbee Mode, a compatible Aqara hub is required).(* To use the device with a particular Matter ecosystem, a Matter Controller of this ecosystem and a Thread Border Router are required).

specs.Special Feature: Dynamic and Static Effects, Perfectly compatible with Aqara switches, Tunable White
